name: Christmas Color
source:
The heroine wends up working part-time at the restaurant run by her cousin during the season of Christmas. It’s the story of the 3 busy yet fun days spent while surrounded by her overprotective cousin and the ill-tempered cook…

[from [url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
女主角在圣诞季到表亲经营的餐厅打工。她将在过度保护自己的表亲和脾气暴躁的厨师围绕下，度过忙碌却快乐的三天……

[来源：[url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
